6:
Gah... How many times do I have to tell you
to stop staring at me while I sleep?!
10:
Actually, I've told you, like, dozens of
times now.
12:
...Seriously, when are you ever going to
start acting human...?
13:
You can probably tell from the wings, but
this unidentified life-form is obviously not
human.
14:
One day she suddenly fell out of the sky
and started calling me "Master."
15:
She's from some place called Synapse, a
Strategic Angeloid, Type Alpha or
whatever... The hard stuff goes over my
head.
16:
The one thing I know for sure is that ever
since she showed up, my peaceful life has
gone right out the window.
17:
She flies, she has zero common sense, she
comes to school, she summons Synapse
items with weird Cards and causes chaos...
18:
Sigh... All I need to be happy is a peaceful
life and some naughty stuff...
19:
Hey, Tomoki... What's with all the moping or
perving or whatever that is, first thing in
the morning?
20: Huh...? Why is Nymph in my room too?!
21:
...What? Are you saying I'm not allowed to
come wake you up?
22:
Anyway, it's your own fault for sleeping in
forever, Tomoki. Hurry up and get up
already.
23:
She's an Angeloid too, obviously. Wings and
all. At some point she just got added to
the household.
24:
Apparently she's an Electronic Warfare
Type Beta, but what she can actually do is
too complicated for me.
25:
Long story short, she has no master, so I
guess she's bored, and she spends every
day eating snacks and watching soap
operas.
26:
Also, she's not as bad as Ikaros, but
she's still short on common sense, so she
causes plenty of trouble too...
27:
Okay, okay, I get it. I'll just hurry up and
get up, then.
28:
Make it quick. Otherwise it's gonna be
unbearably noisy.
30:
I'm hungry~ Let's hurry up and have
breakfast~
32:
She's an Angeloid too, of course. Close
Combat Type Delta or something.
35: ...You came over to eat breakfast again?
36: Ugh... I can't help it... Because... because!
38:
...Uh, you know that's not an excuse for
anything, right?
39:
Eh, whatever. I'll be down in a sec, so get
breakfast ready, Ikaros.
42: What a big yawn... Something wrong, Tomoki?
43:
Yeah, last night was a bit much... Er, I
mean...
45:
Oh, uh... I've kinda had insomnia lately. I
can't sleep well.
46:
Hmm. Unlike you Downers, we don't sleep in
the first place, so I don't really get it,
but...
48:
Hey, Alpha. You were near him, right? Was
Tomoki okay?
49:
...Last night, Master had no health
problems. He was up late reading porn
magazines.
52:
...Alpha, you don't have to apologize to
this guy. Insomnia, my foot.
53:
...And I was actually worried about you!
Ugh, just go wash your face already!
55: Whaaat?! But I wanna eat now~
56: Can't you hold out even a little bit?
58:
Ikaros-senpai, let's start eating without
them!
59: I have to wait until Master comes back...
61:
Oh, I've got a great idea! Why don't you eat
breakfast while you wash your face?
62:
Don't be ridiculous. You wash your face in
the bathroom, and you eat in the living
room.
63: Aww, if only there were two of you.
64:
In that case, I think you'd just send both
of them off to wash their faces...
66:
But you know, maybe it really would be nice
if there were two Tomokis.
67:
What's that supposed to mean? What's so
great about two of me?
68:
Well, you're Alpha's master, aren't you?
So...
70:
...? Anyway, I'm gonna go wash my face, so
just hang on a sec.
74: Hm? Alpha, why are you taking out Cards?
75:
...I was in the middle of sorting them since
last night...
76: Wow, you sure have a lot of those...
77:
But you don't even know what most of
them do, right? What's the point of
keeping them?
79:
Well... I guess that's true. If somebody set
one off by mistake, who knows what would
happen.
81:
Um, Ikaros-senpai! Don't you have a Card
that makes food come out or something?
82:
...Since there might be idiots like this
around.
83:
Still, what does "sorting" them even
involve?
84:
You can't group them by type if you don't
know what they do, right?
85: Maybe checking whether any are damaged?
86:
Counting them, to make sure none are
missing...
87:
...Huh? Those seven over there... don't
they look kind of weird?
90:
Ah, while I'm at it, maybe I'll go get changed
before breakfast.
93:
Whoa?! Hey, Astraea, don't go jumping on
me!
94:
You can't go! Then I'll never get to eat~! I
can't take it anymore~!
95:
Changing will only take a sec... Wait, stop,
ow, that hurts, whoa!
97:
Hey, Alpha! Your Cards are falling! You're
dropping them all over the place!
99:
What are you doing? H-hugging Astraea-san
like that...
101:
This girl with the big boobs is Sohara
Mitsuki, my childhood friend who lives next
door, but...
102:
I'm in way too much trouble right now to
explain her properly. A killer chop is about
to come down on me.
103:
To~mo~cha~a~n? What do you think you're
doing first thing in the morning?
104:
W-wait, Sohara! No chopping! This is all
Astraea's...!!
105:
The President thinks that sort of thing is
still a bit too soon~
106:
Tomoki, they say it's healthiest to eat
breakfast within two hours of waking up.
107:
P-President?! Sugata-senpai?! When did you
get here...?
108: And so, I am having breakfast.
109:
"And so" what?! Why are you eating in
somebody else's house without asking?!
110: Oh, what's the harm~? It's fun.
112:
This is Sugata-senpai. He's smart, but he
started some incomprehensible club called
the New World Discovery Club. Sorami
Town's #1 weirdo.
113:
The Student Council President, as you can
see, is a beauty, but she's a demon of a
woman who only thinks about treating
people like toys.
114:
Between those two, Killer Chop Girl, and the
three Angeloids, my peaceful days are in
pieces...
115: G... give me back my happy days~~!!
116:
Relax, Tomoki. If you find the New World
with me, you're sure to find happiness
too...
117:
Don't you act all high and mighty when
you're one of the culprits! And stop eating!
118: Food~! Give me some food too~!
119: And you, get off me already!
121:
Hey, Alpha! This is no time for that, you're
dropping your Cards!
123:
Mmph, hey... Astraea... Stop thrashing
around on top of me!
124:
Ohhh, pressing that right there... Oh?! This
bounce! Uhehehe!
129: Huh?! Hey, Alpha! Is that okay?!
131:
The Cards! The Cards! Didn't some of them
just activate?!
133: H-hey, what is it? Is something wrong...?
134: Alpha, did you set something off?!
140:
The Cards Ikaros had, which summon
Synapse items, have activated in an
irregular manner.
141:
This is only conjecture... but it's highly
likely they were triggered by the "wish" of
one of the seven of us. Correct, Ikaros?
143:
So... the Cards activated to grant
somebody's wish?
144:
But a wish... I didn't have anything like
that.
146:
Me neither... Oh, I did want to eat
breakfast!
147: Then isn't Delta the most likely one?
148: But I still haven't gotten to eat!
